name: Hananiah
overview: Hananiah was a male figure known primarily as one of the perfumers who contributed to the repair of the wall of Jerusalem, as recorded in Nehemiah 3:8. While his tribal affiliation and additional personal details are not provided, his role in the restoration efforts highlights his involvement in the physical and spiritual rebuilding of the city during a critical period in Israel's history.
namesAndTitles: The name Hananiah means 'YHWH is gracious,' reflecting a recognition of God's kindness and favor. This meaning underscores a common biblical theme of God's grace in the lives of His people. There are no additional titles or names recorded for this individual.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Hananiah beyond his identification as a male perfumer involved in the wall repairs. No further relational details are provided in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Hananiah's significance lies in his contribution to the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls, a vital act of faith and obedience that helped restore the city's security and identity after exile. As one of the perfumers, his work symbolizes the blending of practical service with spiritual dedication, reflecting the holistic nature of the community's restoration under God's guidance. His involvement in Nehemiah's project demonstrates the collective effort of God's people to reestablish their covenantal heritage.
